name: Beijing
description: China's medical capital with the country's highest concentration of top-tier hospitals. Leading in oncology, orthopedics, neurology, and cardiovascular care. The most mature international patient services in China.

name: Shanghai
description: China's most international city with a vibrant expat community. Excellent cardiovascular, digestive health, and oncology care. Many hospitals with long histories of serving foreign patients.

name: Guangzhou
description: Southern China's medical hub, known for ENT (ear, nose, throat), oncology, and reproductive medicine. Conveniently located near Hong Kong with strong international services.

name: Hainan
description: China's tropical island province with special medical tourism policies. Known for wellness, rehabilitation, cosmetic surgery, and anti-aging treatments. Boao Lecheng area offers approved international drugs and devices.
